advertising.docs:
**boolean**: Manually enable BLE advertising support. This is automatically enabled when using [Esp32 Ble Server](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_ble_server/) or [Esp32 Ble Beacon](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_ble_beacon/). Only set this to `true` if you need advertising functionality without those components. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [BLE Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_ble#configuration-variables)*

advertising_cycle_time.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The time interval for cycling through multiple advertisements. Only applicable when advertising is enabled. Defaults to `10s`.

*See also: [BLE Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_ble#configuration-variables)*

sc_mitm_bond.docs: Secure connections with MITM and bonding

auth_req_mode.docs:
**enum**: The authentication request mode. Defaults to the ESP-IDF default. Leave unspecified unless your device needs special handling.

*See also: [BLE Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_ble#configuration-variables)*

connection_timeout.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The maximum time to wait for a BLE connection to be established. Defaults to `20s`.

*See also: [BLE Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_ble#configuration-variables)*

disable_bt_logs.docs:
**boolean**: When enabled, disables Bluetooth logging categories that are not used by the configured components. This saves flash memory by only including the loggers needed by your configuration. Defaults to `true`.

*See also: [BLE Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_ble#configuration-variables)*

enable_on_boot.docs:
**boolean**: If enabled, the BLE interface will be enabled on boot. Defaults to `true`.

*See also: [BLE Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_ble#configuration-variables)*

none.docs: No IO capability (Connections that require PIN code authentication will fail)

keyboard_only.docs: Only a keyboard to enter PIN codes (or a fixed PIN code)

display_only.docs: Only a display to show PIN codes

display_yes_no.docs: A display to show PIN codes and buttons to confirm or deny the connection

io_capability.docs:
**enum**: The IO capability of this ESP32, used for securely connecting to other BLE devices. Defaults to `none`.

*See also: [BLE Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_ble#configuration-variables)*

max_connections.docs:
**integer**: The maximum number of simultaneous BLE connections (client + server combined). Defaults to `3`.

*See also: [BLE Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_ble#configuration-variables)*

max_key_size.docs:
**integer**: Maximum encryption key size to support. Must be between `7` and `16`. Leave unspecified to use the ESP32 default unless your device needs special handling.

*See also: [BLE Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_ble#configuration-variables)*

max_notifications.docs:
**integer**: The maximum number of BLE characteristics that can have notifications enabled across all connections. Defaults to `12`.

*See also: [BLE Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_ble#configuration-variables)*

min_key_size.docs:
**integer**: Minimum encryption key size requirement from peer. Must be between `7` and `16`. Leave unspecified to use the ESP32 default unless your device needs special handling.

*See also: [BLE Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_ble#configuration-variables)*

name.docs:
**string**: The name of the BLE device.

*See also: [BLE Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_ble#configuration-variables)*

use_psram.docs:
**boolean**: Requests that the Bluetooth stack allocate its memory buffers from PSRAM instead of internal RAM, freeing approximately 40 kB for other uses. Defaults to `false`. Requires PSRAM to be configured.

*See also: [BLE Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_ble#configuration-variables)*
